sources.title: Altered RBC aggregability in diabetes: a threshold for ...
sources.snippet: Using AI as our RBCA measure, this study had three objectives. The first was to characterize RBCA differences in diabetes and its variation from RBCD. The second was to investigate associations with diabetes-related clinical, inflammatory and endocrine parameters for both RBCA and RBCD.
